The HPC Systems Section is responsible for the division’s computing, storage, networking, and infrastructure systems and services. review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Basic Qualifications: BS degree in a scientific or technical field. 8+ years of Linux systems experience is required. Preferred Qualifications: Experience managing Linux operating systems in a large-scale system environment. 8+ years of experience with Linux Cluster Administration. Special Requirements: This position requires the ability to obtain and maintain a clearance from the Department of Energy.
